title: 第30章 你跪下，我求你一件事！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
潘春宇和许彦霖心里打的如意算盘是，只要梁惟石到了县公安局，那就等于砧板上的鱼肉，任由他们宰割了。

    常务副局长闻鑫平是他爹的嫡系，分管刑侦、治安的副局长谢凯和他称兄道弟，治安管理大队长郝毅，也和他们一个鼻孔出气。

    县公安局上上下下几乎都是我的人，你拿什么和我斗？

    至于像程勇这种看不清形势的小虾米，哼，明天就让闻鑫平打发到哪个犄角旮旯去，省得碍眼。

    由于双方达成了一致意见，所以事情暂时得以顺利的解决。

    梁惟石与潘春宇、许彦霖及余文宏几人，分乘两辆车来到了县公安局。

    看着眼前笼罩在暮色之中的公安局大楼，梁惟石眼中闪过一抹怀念的神色。

    如果按上一世的轨迹，他应该在明年听从老爹的建议，报考了县公安局指挥中心。然后以笔试面试第一的优秀成绩被录取，从而开始了长达二十年的官场生涯。

    仔细算算，其中至少有七年的时间，他是在县公安局度过的。

    上到局领导，下到身边同事，对整个县局的情况，他不说了如指掌吧，至少也是如数家珍。

    也正是这个原因，他并不担心自己会遭受什么不公平的待遇，回县公安局对他来说，其实就和回家没什么区别！

    治安管理大队长郝毅拉拉着一张脸，把程勇、王进和吴俊叫了过去，劈头盖脸地就是一顿臭骂。

    “你们三个是不是傻？啊？潘春宇和余文宏是你们能得罪的？信不信过了今晚，你们三个就得滚去乡派出所报到去。地方我都给你们选好了，梅花乡、红河乡，还有石垃子乡，正好你们一人一个！”

    程勇三人一声不吭，因为他们知道大队长是为了他们好。

    “大队长，那个，我们也不能光听潘春宇的啊，梁惟石可是宋书记的秘书，昨天晚上还和咱们刘局喝酒了呢！”

    “还有，今晚是梁惟石先遭遇了袭击，差点儿被郭铁和胡大彪给捅死，而这两个人和潘春宇、余文宏刚刚在一起吃饭，你说梁惟石能不怀疑？能不生气？能不动手？”

    程勇是情况怎么严重怎么说，怎么有利于梁惟石怎么说。

    王进和吴俊也在旁边一个劲儿地点头，证明程副大队说的都是实情。

    郝毅听了面上不禁闪过一抹凝重，若有所思地坐了下来。

    梁惟石就算再没背景，至少还有着县委书记联络员这层身份，不管是谁，你可以不把梁惟石当盘菜，但你不能不考虑宋书记的态度。

    刚刚他接到谢副局长的电话，也只是说要坐实梁惟石殴打余文宏和潘春宇的事实，但也没说要对梁惟石采取什么手段。
content_en:
Pan Chunyu and Xu Yanlin's wishful thinking was that as long as Liang Weishi arrived at the county public security bureau, it would be like fish on the chopping board, free to be slaughtered by them.

    Executive Deputy Director Wen Xinping is a direct descendant of his father. Deputy Director in charge of criminal investigation and public security Xie Kai is his brother-in-law. Hao Yi, the captain of the Public Security Management Brigade, also vents his anger on them.

    Almost everyone in the county public security bureau works for me. Why are you fighting me?

    As for little shrimps like Cheng Yong who can't see the situation clearly, well, let Wen Xinping send him to some nook and cranny tomorrow to avoid being an eyesore.

    Since both parties reached an agreement, the matter was resolved smoothly for the time being.

    Liang Weishi, Pan Chunyu, Xu Yanlin and Yu Wenhong arrived in two cars at the County Public Security Bureau.

    Looking at the Public Security Bureau building shrouded in twilight, Liang Weishi had a look of nostalgia in his eyes.

    If he followed the trajectory of his previous life, he should have followed his father's advice next year and applied for the command center of the County Public Security Bureau. Then he was admitted with the best score in the written examination and interview, thus beginning his twenty-year official career.

    After careful calculation, he spent at least seven years in the county public security bureau.

    From the bureau leaders down to his colleagues, he knew everything about the entire county bureau, at least he knew everything about it.

    It is for this reason that he is not worried that he will suffer any unfair treatment. For him, returning to the County Public Security Bureau is actually no different from going home!

    Hao Yi, captain of the Public Security Management Brigade, pulled Cheng Yong, Wang Jin and Wu Jun over and cursed them.

    "Are you three stupid? Huh? Pan Chunyu and Yu Wenhong are the ones you can offend? Believe it or not, after tonight, you three will have to report to the township police station. I have chosen the place for you, Meihua Township, Honghe Township, and Shilazi Township, just one for each of you!"

    Cheng Yong and the other three remained silent because they knew the captain was doing it for their own good.

    "Captain, um, we can't just listen to Pan Chunyu. Liang Weishi is Secretary Song's secretary, and he drank with our Director Liu last night!"

    "Also, it was Liang Weishi who was attacked first tonight and was almost stabbed to death by Guo Tie and Hu Dabiao. These two people, Pan Chunyu and Yu Wenhong, just had dinner together. Do you think Liang Weishi can not be suspicious? Can he not be angry? Can he not take action?"

    Cheng Yong said how serious the situation was and how it was beneficial to Liang Weishi.

    Wang Jin and Wu Jun were also nodding their heads beside them, proving that what Deputy Brigade Cheng said was true.

    After hearing this, Hao Yi couldn't help but have a look of solemnity on his face, and sat down thoughtfully.

    Even if Liang Weishi has no background, at least he still has the status of liaison officer of the county party committee secretary. No matter who he is, you don't have to treat Liang Weishi as a dish, but you can't help but consider Secretary Song's attitude.

    He just received a call from Deputy Director Xie, who only said that he would confirm the fact that Liang Weishi beat up Yu Wenhong and Pan Chunyu, but did not say what measures he would take against Liang Weishi.
title_en: Chapter 30 Kneel down and let me ask you something!
